The '''Katanos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Xan sector/Legends|Xan sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katanos VII]].
